description: Source code for redis-benchmark, a utility for benchmarking Redis server performance. Contains implementation of client creation, request handling, cluster management, and latency reporting.

classes.name: client
classes.description: Represents a Redis client connection with buffers, state, and cluster info.

classes.name: benchmarkThread
classes.description: Represents a benchmarking thread with its own event loop.

classes.name: clusterNode
classes.description: Represents a Redis cluster node with slot and replication info.

classes.name: redisConfig
classes.description: Holds Redis configuration parameters such as save and appendonly settings.

methods.name: redisGitSHA1
methods.description: Returns the current Git SHA1 hash of Redis source.

methods.name: redisGitDirty
methods.description: Indicates if the Redis source has uncommitted changes.

methods.name: writeHandler
methods.description: Handles writable events for a client socket.

methods.name: createMissingClients
methods.description: Creates additional clients to reach the target number of clients.

methods.name: execBenchmarkThread
methods.description: Function executed by each benchmark thread.

methods.name: createClusterNode
methods.description: Creates a new cluster node object.

methods.name: getRedisContext
methods.description: Establishes a Redis connection, optionally TLS.

methods.name: fetchClusterSlotsConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches cluster slot configuration from Redis.
